newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 36 Kurdish rebels in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 36 Kurdish rebels in southeast.

text.p: Thirty-six Kurdish rebels and four soldiers have died in clashes in southeast Turkey, statements from the emergency rule governor's office said on Wednesday.
Security forces killed 36 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in Siirt, Tunceli, Batman and Bingol provinces and four soldiers died in the fighting in Siirt, the statements said.
The office did not say when the clashes took place.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between troops and the PKK, fighting for autonomy or independence in the country's mainly Kurdish southeast.
